title: Portal to Nova Roma: Omnibus: Books 1-3
author: J.R. Mathews
note: conf=0.94; Amazon listing confirms this is an omnibus edition collecting the first three books of the "Portal to Nova Roma" LitRPG/system-apocalypse series by J.R. Mathews.
